sources.evidence: Laneway Music's official artist roster explicitly lists Celibate Rifles and Damien Lovelock, confirming the intended Australian band and its Laneway connection.
The Spotify artist profile identifies The Celibate Rifles and presents the band's catalogue, including Johnny, Wonderful Life '88 and Sideroxylon material.
Apple Music identifies Sideroxylon as a 1983 Celibate Rifles album carrying a Laneway Music copyright and provides a direct licensed catalogue destination.
I-94 Bar's long-form oral history uses first-hand recollections from band members to document the band's Northern Beaches beginnings, early performances and musical character.
The first-hand history places the band's beginnings in 1979 in schools, surf clubs and garages on Sydney's Northern Beaches.
AllMusic describes the Celibate Rifles as Sydney clever punk rock and explicitly notes the band's Sex Pistols-referencing name.
ABC Double J identifies Damien Lovelock as the band's magnetic frontman from 1980 and records his wider work in soccer, books, radio and television.
ABC Double J reports that the Celibate Rifles released nine studio albums and remained a potent live act for decades.
Apple Music identifies Sideroxylon as the band's 1983 eleven-song album and credits Laneway Music.
